page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose cloud virtual instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 72 dedicated vCPUs from the Intel Xeon 8163 processor family running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. Accompanying the compute capacity is 288.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB per vCPU. It lacks dedicated local SSD storage and GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage solutions.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth rate of 33 Gbps, facilitating high-volume data transfers between instance nodes and cloud services. Lacking integrated local storage and GPU hardware, the instance concentrates its resource footprint entirely on standard CPU and RAM density. This operational profile offers efficient scaling for workloads requiring substantial parallel CPU threads without the added overhead of local NVMe arrays or graphics processing units.

Given its 72 vCPUs and 288 GB memory configuration, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge instance is suited for enterprise-level general-purpose applications. Typical deployment scenarios include high-concurrency web serving, large backend application servers, container orchestration nodes, microservices platforms, and distributed data processing frameworks where external persistent block storage is utilized.
